thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate across eu-west-1. Error rate 12% over 3m, baseline 0.5% :rotating_light:

Maria Chen: seeing a lot of gateway 502s and worker 504s - our dashboard shows a spike starting ~2m ago.

Ajay Patel: I'm on it. first pass: is this the new quantized model rollout?

Dana Ortiz: no rollout scheduled for eu-west-1, last deploy was 30m ago. deploy-bot: last deploy: model-service@release-2026-02-08 at 2519999000 by deploy pipeline.

Kai Nakamura: collecting logs from affected hosts. attaching tail of model-runner stderr:

Kai Nakamura: ```
[2026-02-12T12:03:21Z] model-runner[pid=4021]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c87...
[2026-02-12T12:03:21Z] kernel: out_of_memory: kill process 4021 (model-runner) score 987
[2026-02-12T12:03:21Z] model-runner[pid=4021]: double free or corruption
```

Tyler Brooks: that looks like an OOM followed by segfaults. Which model and sequence lengths are we seeing?

Maria Chen: traffic shows long tails — several requests with seq_len ~4096 due to customer X batch prompts. We hit memory cliff on a few VMs.

Ajay Patel: on a handful of nodes the runtime is crashing and restarting -> 5xx cascade. Putting node list in ops channel.

Dana Ortiz: mitigation options: 1) auto-reroute traffic off eu-west-1 to eu-central for premium customers, 2) disable the heavy-context model variant and fallback to base quantized model, 3) increase instance swap/oom-killer thresholds (risky).

Maria Chen: quick customer-impact check: CS reported escalations from Customer X and Y (chat ops). They are on Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 -> data isolation prevents cross-region reroute for Dedicated. :worried:

Kai Nakamura: starting live tail of container metrics and increasing log level. running command: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-runner --since=5m --tail=200`

Tyler Brooks: trying option 2 now: disabling model-variant 'r-large-k-q8' by updating routing policy to prefer 'r-base-q4' for new requests. Applying rollout canary config.

deploy-bot: Reroute rule applied: routing-policy/avoid-r-large-k-q8 -> updated by Tyler Brooks at 2523456105.

incident-bot: NOTE: Routing change propagated to 6/8 edge nodes. Latency may increase by ~15% for affected requests.

Ajay Patel: after flip, error rate dropped to 4.2% but still above baseline. Some nodes still crash under GC churn.

Maria Chen: enabling aggressive prefix/KV caching for live traffic to reduce token compute. Policy change pushed to cache-service.

Dana Ortiz: for Dedicated customers affected, raising urgent CS ticket to coordinate mitigation and offer temporary traffic shaping.

Kai Nakamura: found kernel logs on node gw-12 showing repeated cgroup memory events, container killed by kernel each crash. suspect memory leak in latest runtime hotfix.

Tyler Brooks: can we roll back that hotfix on eu-west-1 model-runner? It's tagged as runtime-5.3.1-hotfix.

Ajay Patel: rollback scheduled but needs coord with infra for nodes hosting Dedicated pools. Requesting approval from infra lead.

Maria Chen: we need short-term isolation: evict noncritical pods from affected GPU nodes and cordon two nodes to stop flapping. Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets gpu-node-17`

incident-bot: Pager duty note created and paged on-call for infra: Dana Ortiz.

Dana Ortiz: I'll take on infra handoff. Maria, leave notes and list of evicted pods. I'll coordinate rollback/upgrade path.

Maria Chen: evicted pods list saved to /tmp/evicted-2523456789.log and pushed to incident channel.

Tyler Brooks: rollback initiated on canary subset of nodes. monitoring errors.

Ajay Patel: after cordon+evict+rollback, error rate down to 0.8% and customer X reports partial recovery. Still watching for residual timeouts.

Kai Nakamura: CPU/mem graphs show memory plateau now normalizing. No more segfaults on rolled-back nodes.

Dana Ortiz: taking over for next 2 hours. handoff: current state -> routing fallback active, 2 nodes cordoned (gpu-node-17, gpu-node-21), rollback in progress on 4 canary nodes, incident mitigations: caching + routing. Action items: finish full rollback or patch mem leak, coordinate Dedicated pool exceptions, run postmortem.

Maria Chen: adding customer-impact summary: Affected customers: Customer X (high), Customer Y (medium), ~1200 API calls failed at peak window 12:03-12:15 UTC. Revenue exposure estimate: low-mid 4 figures.

Tyler Brooks: I'll open infra PR to revert runtime-5.3.1-hotfix and add memory regression test to CI.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATE: mitigated -> watching. Next update by Dana Ortiz in 30m or on major change. :white_check_mark:

Dana Ortiz: handoff note posted. tagging oncall rotation for followup and postmortem: @Maria Chen, @Ajay Patel, @Tyler Brooks, @Kai Nakamura.

Maria Chen: thanks team — I'll draft the timeline and initial root-cause hypotheses for postmortem.

Ajay Patel: leaving logs/trace links in the shared drive: https://internal/redwood/incidents/2523456789

Tyler Brooks: closing command for now: I'll keep a watch loop for 1 hour. :eyes:
